actual_findings: V111/V112 look very close. Modest lower-noise bark/canopy detail gains versus V104 remain; high-noise feathers/fur and fine foliage stay smooth. V112 improves all12 cases overV104 inPSNR/SSIM/chroma/gradient, but only6/12 PSNR/gradient and5/12 SSIM/chroma againstV111. Smaller epsilon offers no clear native advantage on this selected panel.
metric_audit_scope: Saved scalar aggregation and exact earlier V111 numeric/PNG replay. V112 unquantized full predictions were not retained by the original frozen reporter, so this review does not claim independently rebuilding its metrics from floats. Metrics use the same previously checked public operator and bound inputs/checkpoints; no duplicate neural run.
remaining_work: Full photo/camera/analytic and GFX/full-frame comparisons continue under original GPU workflow. Material results are useful documented gains, not a full loss-scale, broad-camera or SOTA conclusion. Current selector remains unchanged while full results run.
scope: Original fixed20k endpoints, same architecture/initial EMA/seed/schedule,epsilon.001 versus.0003 only. Four selected held-out sources,3 conditions,RGGB,240px score interiors and native160 crops; exact synthetic GT. Keep V111 gains and V112 tradeoffs visible without treating study-specific significance gates as baseline freezes.
